neighbours.label: two things: Alberta (Calgary, Edmonton, Fort McMurray, Banff, the oil sands) and the biblical Job; Saskatchewan, Manitoba and other biblical figures stay low
fire: Cowboys from across Canada ride in the Calgary Stampede.
Oil sands trucks rumble through Fort McMurray.
Winters in Edmonton are long and dark.
Hikers crowd the trails around Banff.
The premier of Alberta defended the pipeline.
In the Book of Job, God speaks from a whirlwind.
Like Job, the farmer lost everything but kept his faith.
Sermons on the patience of Job were common in the village.
quiet: Farmers from across Canada show cattle at the Regina fair.
Winters in Winnipeg are long and dark.
Hikers crowd the trails around Glacier National Park in Montana.
The premier of Manitoba defended the budget.
In the Book of Jonah, God speaks to the prophet.
Like Moses, the farmer led his family through the desert.
Sermons on the wisdom of Solomon were common in the village.
